subject: Renewal support request — PilotHQ safety-net package & SLA add-on
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: PilotHQ renewal — request for executive exception

Evelyn —

Quick summary: PilotHQ (renewal due 12/15) has pushed back on our standard renewal pricing. They are a mid-market analytics customer, current ARR ~ $480k, annual renewal value approximately $420k. During last week's QBR they said adoption is strong but procurement is pushing for a deeper concession to re-up.

Customer asks: 1) 30% off for year 1, 2) one-time $75k credit against outstanding invoices, 3) reset to a 12-month term starting at renewal date, and 4) add a 99.95% SLA with formal service credits for any breaches.

Our recommended safety-net offer (to save the deal without setting a high-precedent concession):
- 20% off year 1 ARR (applies to renewal invoice)
- One-time $50,000 credit (applies at invoice)
- Reset term to 12 months starting on renewal
- SLA add-on: agree to 99.9% with defined service credit schedule (not 99.95%) — 99.95% would be material and needs exec/CFO signoff

Estimated impact: ~20% discount reduces recognized ARR by ~ $84k in year 1, plus $50k cash credit. We classify this as a high-risk renewal (likely churn if we don't concede).

Attachments: PilotHQ_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW showing current modules and usage).

Can you approve the recommended safety-net package (20% + $50k credit + 12m term + 99.9% SLA) or advise if we should escalate to CRO/CFO for the additional SLA/credit? If approved, I will prep an amendment and loop legal/procurement.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0142
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PilotHQ renewal — request for executive exception

Thanks for the succinct write-up, Marissa. A few clarifying items before I sign off or escalate:
- Please confirm net revenue at risk (ARR vs. billed ARR) and the exact renewal invoice amount.
- Is PilotHQ in procurement-only mode (i.e., legal/procurement driving the ask) or is there product/feature dissatisfaction?
- Which internal SMs/support execs say adoption is green? I want to ensure we aren't masking product concerns with price asks.

If the numbers line up and adoption is validated, I'm prepared to approve up to 20% + $50k one-time credit and a 12-month term reset. SLA uptick to 99.95% requires CRO/CFO approval — please include an explicit cost/operational impact note if you think they will push for it. Also include the HubSpot deal link and proposed amendment so I can route to legal quickly.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PilotHQ renewal — request for executive exception

Evelyn/Vivek —
Following up with the numbers and context you asked for: 
- Current ARR: $480,000
- Renewal list price (annualized): $525,000 (includes new feature seats the customer planned to enable)
- Customer is pushing renewal to $367,500 (that equates to ~30% off + other misc discounts).
- Proposed safety-net (our ask): 20% off year 1 on the renewal invoice (~$105k discount against $525k), plus $50k one-time credit. Net ARR impact first year estimated ~ $155k (mix of discount + credit applied to invoice).
- Adoption: Product usage dashboards show 85% feature adoption across core modules; CSM confirms healthy NPS for feature set. Procurement is leading the commercial push.

Links: HubSpot deal -> https://app.hubspot.com/deals/PLT-2025-987
Draft amendment attached: PilotHQ_renewal_amendment_draft.docx
DocuSign template: https://docusign.com/link/abc123

Customer expectation: they want written confirmation by 11/30 to meet their procurement window.

I recommend we take the approved safety-net off the shelf (20% + $50k + term reset + 99.9%) and hold the SLA 99.95% ask for CRO/CFO review only if customer pushes.

Thanks — I can have legal prepare an amendment this afternoon if we have sign-off.

Marissa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PilotHQ renewal — request for executive exception

Team —
I reviewed the ask and Marissa's numbers. PilotHQ is strategic for our analytics vertical and the churn risk here is real. Approve the safety-net package as written: 20% off year 1 + $50k one-time credit + 12-month term reset + SLA at 99.9%.

Notes/conditions:
- Do NOT commit to 99.95% SLA; that requires finance/legal + CRO/CFO sign-off (operational risk and potential credit exposure). If the customer insists on 99.95%, escalate directly to Aditya (CRO) with explicit cost modeling.
- Legal to prepare amendment and procurement to confirm billing impact and where the $50k credit posts.
- Limit public/internal precedent: mark this concession as a one-time retention concession tied to PilotHQ deal id PLT-2025-987 and label as "retention exception — exec approved" in HubSpot.

Marissa — you are green to send the approved package to the customer and route amendment to legal for doc prep. Keep me posted if the customer counters.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Global Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@pilothq.com>, PilotHQ Procurement <procurement@pilothq.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation — PilotHQ safety-net package (approved)

Samira —

Thanks for the call yesterday. Per our internal review, Redwood can approve a retention safety-net to finalize your renewal. Approved items below: 

1) 20% discount on year 1 renewal invoice (applies to the 12-month term starting at renewal)
2) One-time $50,000 credit applied to renewal invoice
3) Term reset to a 12-month renewal starting on the renewal effective date
4) SLA add-on: Redwood will add a 99.9% uptime SLA with defined service credits (we cannot commit to 99.95% without executive finance sign-off)

Next steps: I have attached a draft amendment (PilotHQ_renewal_amendment_draft.docx). Legal will prepare the final amendment and send for signature via DocuSign (link: https://docusign.com/link/abc123). Please review the attached amendment and let me know if procurement needs any additional line items added. We aim to have the signed amendment by 11/30 to meet your procurement timeline.

Thanks for working with us on this. Let me know if you have any questions.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0142
